# Dafeiyu-GO Connect frozen package

The bundled `dafeiyu-go-connect-0.3.0.tgz` is the frozen 200,430-byte shared host candidate for PC and Android, protocol `dafeiyu-go.connection.v1`.

SHA-256: `4f3657730459197835a014b7f7433b44cc652e5b32480cdb37c061b160e75bf2` (200,430 bytes).

The build verifies the exact digest and manifest before copying assets. This candidate adds separately gated artifact and attachment operations, authenticated terminal consumption ACKs and bounded receipt retirement to the remote task/workspace contracts. Destructive disk removal requires a reviewed exact path after native tasks settle; durable removed-directory admission gates prevent new steps. Artifact, attachment and webpage production capabilities remain disabled pending real end-to-end verification. New archive source modules are included but are not imported by the production adapter, and their installation hook is not invoked.

Source: the sibling Dafeiyu-GO-Connect-Plugin repository, package version 0.3.0, project license MIT. Full license text accompanies this candidate in `LICENSE`. The final freeze must also carry that text in its archive; this candidate has not been published. No API keys, device identity or pairing credentials are bundled.
